resource_contract.detail: A real external transform that expands represented output is rejected by common projected-output admission before its lowering hook allocates the expanded circuit.
An impossible syndrome returns its typed decode failure before mutating any record in the caller-owned prediction batch.
Pauli, flow, tableau, iterator, solver, and unitary limits reject before materialization or RNG consumption.
Detector, observable, and represented-mechanism admission accepts each exact frozen maximum and rejects the first value above it with a typed limit error.
Represented DEM instruction traversal accepts exactly 65,536 visits and rejects the first excess before exact-ML state-table work begins.
Generated repetition circuits and every exact A7 compile/decode diagnostic model are checked across all admitted detector syndromes against an independent probability-domain dynamic program.
Canonical circuit parsing, append operations, and printing preserve Stim syntax and model boundaries.
The exact flat error-heavy qualification family proves varied probabilities, detector and observable targets, separators, and canonical output.
The case materializes only fixed representative values; the source-owned Algebra resource-admission parents own maximum accepted sizes, first rejection, and overflow behavior.

The exact boundary case proves Clifford construction, concatenation, and repetition limits, checked size overflow, empty repetition behavior, bounded iterator consumption, and rejection before caller-owned RNG use.

The external reference transform inserts noise only after represented unitary instructions whose target groups are independent single-qubit applications, leaving measurements, annotations, pair gates, and Pauli-product operations unchanged.

Out-of-place transpose allocates exactly one checked transposed result buffer without mutating its source; in-place square transpose uses bounded stack scratch with zero heap allocation and rejects rectangular shapes before mutation.
The case materializes only fixed representative values; the source-owned Algebra resource-admission parents own maximum accepted sizes, first rejection, and overflow behavior.
A BitBlock is exactly four u64 lanes; constructors, accessors, Boolean kernels, and popcount use fixed-size values with no input-sized allocation.

The exhaustive iterator matches an independent sparse enumerator across runtime and word-boundary scales, preserves borrowed and owned order through clone and restart, accepts the exact constructor maximum, and rejects the first excess.
An unresolved posterior whose exact dyadic limb table first exceeds 32 MiB returns the typed workspace error before allocation or a guessed prediction.
The benchmark prerequisite proves model-layout projection, whole-versus-partitioned decode equivalence, and state reuse for caller-owned bounded batches.

A fixed corpus proves accepted whitespace, aliases, comments, fusion, repeats, record and Pauli targets plus malformed gate, argument, target, and record forms; parser-wide admission limits have independent CQ owners.
A compiled exact-ML session performs allocation-free reused decoding and produces the same complete prediction batch across whole and partitioned calls.
Construction checks rows times words-per-row before allocation; row access and mutation stay within the preallocated matrix, and row kernels use constant SIMD scratch.
The separately compiled external pass projects inserted item, target, argument, and opaque-tag logical payload and performs zero allocations when projected payload bytes exceed the admitted limit.
The model traverses represented DEM error mechanisms through borrowed views and an absolute typed target iterator without allocating one target vector per represented mechanism.
A separately compiled Stable crate inserts deterministic typed X noise through only the public model and pass APIs without changing the gate registry or execution IR.

Exact-ML predictions cover probability-zero and probability-one mechanisms, duplicate target parity, deterministic ties, arbitrarily small representable strict majorities, and zero-observable models within the admitted state table.

One bounded circuit proves deterministic Auto-to-scalar selection, explicit scalar selection, identical immutable plan identity, and typed rejection of the not-yet-registered portable-SIMD backend before execution.

The external experiment composes public analysis, sampling, measurement-to-detection, typed detection delivery, decoding, and logical-failure counting with bounded batches and deterministic partition-equivalent seeded execution.
The external pass keeps nested repeat blocks folded and preserves coordinates, complete target lists, source tags, and opaque non-UTF-8 metadata exactly.
Repeated mutable prefix borrowing and admitted prediction writes allocate no memory after caller-owned storage construction.

Thread-local allocator instrumentation proves that a live compiled exact-ML session retains one allocation containing exactly one prediction byte for each admitted detector syndrome after every temporary probability workspace is released.

A limb-heavy unresolved posterior whose exact table fits the byte workspace but exceeds the independent 2^28 limb-transition budget returns the typed work-limit error before exact allocation or iteration.

The internal directed intervals enclose and the fixed-limb exact dyadic convolution equals independent direct subset enumeration across a bounded exhaustive matrix of two-mechanism effects and probability edges.
The exact folded-repeat qualification family proves nested tagged repeat blocks remain compact while preserving large semantic shifts.
CircuitPass validates admitted output and preserves framework and implementation diagnostics across successful and rejected transformations.
The exact coordinate and sparse-ID qualification family proves tags, coordinate shifts, and high detector and observable identifiers.
The complete scalar table uses fixed-size enum values and no input-sized allocation.
Each in-place logical operation traverses the preallocated ceil(width/64) words with constant SIMD scratch and canonicalizes the logical tail without allocating output storage.

Every syndrome in a 4,096-syndrome model can be finite and exactly tied while thread-local allocator instrumentation observes only the retained 4,096-byte prediction allocation after exact certification, excluding a retained syndrome-index or ambiguity table.
CircuitPass rejects input, projected-output, actual-output, and arithmetic excess at the owning framework stage.
The model admits the exact represented mechanism count before callbacks and stops immediately when the visitor requests it.
Owned storage is exactly ceil(width/64) words and borrowed views allocate nothing; the deterministic corpus spans empty, unaligned, word, SIMD-lane, multi-lane, and 65,537-bit widths.
Canonical DEM parsing and printing preserve tags, repeat structure, numeric syntax, and terminal newlines.
The exact Stim v1.16.0 hash corpus contains 82 fixed names and expected values, including NOT_A_GATE, and does not grow with caller input.

Sparse construction and XOR allocate at most the combined input cardinality; the deterministic corpus crosses stack and heap merge thresholds and compares every result with a dense bit-vector reference.

An independently reconstructed rich request digest binds the model fingerprint, sampling operation, compiler schema, zero caller options, and zero configurable compile limits without compilation, execution, or heap allocation.

The estimator traverses folded circuit structure once with depth-bounded inline storage, reports exact representable structure and fixed-width output facts, degrades nested repeat multiplication, measurement-count, fixed-width output, and sparse output size to unknown, and neither compiles nor executes the request.

Equivalent circuit text with comments, gate aliases, case changes, LF or CRLF, Unicode tags, repeats, all target variants, and exact floating-point values produces one deterministic structural fingerprint. Hashing allocates no heap through the parser's repeat envelope and uses depth-only spill beyond it.

This case proves canonical printing of aliases, plain and classical pair targets, measurement targets, detector and observable records, probabilities, Pauli lists, and empty, tagged-empty, and nested-empty repeats.
The real exact-ML session shares canonical detector, correction, shot-capacity, mutation, and pre-cancellation behavior with the independent conformance session.
